message.content: {"claims":[{"quote":"Our primary customers are adults aged 28 to 45 with a university degree who live in large cities."},{"quote":"Our second market is freelance photographers who invoice ten or more clients a month and wait more than 45 days to be paid."},{"quote":"About four million people in the country work for themselves."},{"quote":"Maria is a 34-year-old photographer in Leeds who sends twelve invoices a month and tracks them in a spreadsheet."}],"needs":[{"quote":"We want to serve everyone who sends an invoice."},{"quote":"They reconcile accounts for several small clients and lose hours chasing missing receipts."},{"quote":"Freelancers need to know which invoices are overdue."}],"stories":[{"quote":"As a freelance photographer, I want automatic reminders so that clients pay on time."}],"dependencies":[{"quote":"Delivery depends on the payments team opening their sandbox to us."}]}
